verdict.rationale: A startup program or accelerator/incubator partnership is a fair question for a full-service law firm, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions any accelerator, incubator, university-ecosystem partnership, or structured early-stage startup program. It shows only individual startup matters (CTO exit, IP diligence) and VC fund work, which are adjacent to this story and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm documents programs or partnerships with accelerators, incubators, or university ecosystems that give early startups structured access
